MEET OUR OWNER

Technical knowledge.
Hands-on leadership.

B. Nandakumar is a Mechanical Engineering graduate and industry leader with over 30 years of experience in stone quarrying and crushing. Since 1995, his work has focused on operational excellence, technical precision, and the reliable supply of quality construction aggregates.

As a managing partner of Venkatramana Blue Metals, alongside E. Kamalaveni, he brings practical expertise in quarry management, crushing plant machinery, and modern production workflows. His engineering background supports an approach centred on efficient operations and responsible working practices.

KNOWLEDGE BEHIND THE OPERATIONS

Engineering meets experience.

Quarry management

Three decades of hands-on experience in quarry and crusher operations, with a focus on dependable production.

Plant & machinery

Mechanical engineering expertise applied to crushing equipment, technical precision, and production workflows.

Industry representation

As Joint Secretary of the State Quarry and Crusher Association, he works with industry stakeholders to address operational challenges and promote fair practices.
